label: H.R. 8016
title: Forever Chemical Regulation and Accountability Act of 2026

items.snippet: The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) must require each manufacturer and user of PFAS to submit annual reports that include specified information…

Not later than 10 years after the enactment of this bill, manufacturers and users must fully phase out nonessential uses of PFAS. The bill also establishes specified deadlines to phase out the sale of certain products containing PFAS;
requires federal agencies, to the maximum extent practicable, to eliminate the procurement of products known to contain PFAS;

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.

M001143.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
M001143.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
M001143.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
